You don't fear the hard work. You freeze at the very first step.

Which is it for you right now — frozen at the door, or finally crossing the threshold? Comment: FROZEN or MOVING. That's one god inside you named. Every part of you has one — follow Gods of the Mind and we'll meet them all, until you see the whole of yourself.
